Case studies

Four applications, four stories.

Controlling a Superconducting Compact Accelerator for Medical Sterilization

At Fermilab IARC, Blinky-Lite integrates monitoring and control for a test stand supporting development of a compact superconducting electron accelerator. The video explores its potential application in medical sterilization and the systems used to test and protect the accelerator.

Watch the video

Controlling a Compact Neutron Source for BNCT

Discover how a Blinky-Lite-based control system brings together RF, timing, vacuum and cooling systems for a compact neutron source. The video explores the monitoring, diagnostics and protection of its radio-frequency quadrupole accelerator.

Watch the video

Smart Monitoring for Chemical Dispensers

Explore ConcenSmart, a Blinky-Lite integration for remotely monitoring Dosify dispensers and tracking concentrate containers. The video demonstrates usage history, alerts and role-based access using a digital twin network.

Watch the video

Modernizing Heat Pump Control to Reduce Energy Costs

See how Blinky-Lite added electricity spot-price control to Autoseum’s existing heat pump system, switching between the heat pump and district heating without replacing the equipment. The solution saved the museum an average of approximately SEK 2,800 per day during the winter of 2022.

Watch the video
